defaults.control: a negative control that lands with the closing leaf, in the same pull request (decision D4)
defaults.environment: a stack built from the commit under test (harness/compose.yml + tests/conformance/compose.yml); no 62d4eae images are pulled
defaults.retained_evidence: redacted request and response summaries and their checksums; fixture artifacts kept 14 days, receipts 90

fixtures.attack: An anonymous caller reaches an execution or render route
fixtures.control: selftest/test_negative_controls.py: the account step off, and the body checked before the account
fixtures.setup: none; the fixture sends no account
fixtures.guarantee: every admitted route refuses a request that carries no account before it starts work

fixtures.attack: One account reads another account's result; the quota and in-flight sub-cases
fixtures.control: selftest/test_negative_controls.py: another account's rows readable, and a foreign id answering unlike a missing one
fixtures.setup: two synthetic accounts; account A creates one result row
fixtures.teardown: both accounts removed with the admin token
fixtures.guarantee: a signed-in account cannot read another account's result by id, and a foreign id reads the same as a missing one; the quota-drain and in-flight sub-cases are a pending row for ROUNDS-00A-L03

fixtures.attack: A demo actor resets its own limit flags
fixtures.control: selftest/test_negative_controls.py: client writes to the demo flags accepted
fixtures.setup: one synthetic account
fixtures.teardown: the account removed with the admin token
fixtures.guarantee: a client write to is_demo or the demo usage flags on its own record does not change them

fixtures.attack: An oversized request body, and caller-chosen limits
fixtures.control: selftest/test_negative_controls.py: the byte cap waiting for the body, and caller fields accepted
fixtures.setup: none; the fixture sends filler bytes
fixtures.guarantee: a body over the route cap is refused 413 payload_too_large before it is read; the caller-limit sub-cases close with ROUNDS-00A-L02

fixtures.attack: Shell injection through a caller test_command
fixtures.control: selftest/test_negative_controls.py: caller fields accepted
fixtures.setup: one synthetic account; the enforced execution-definitions gate
fixtures.teardown: the account removed with the admin token
fixtures.guarantee: with server-owned definitions enforced, a caller-supplied test_command is refused legacy_request_rejected before anything runs

fixtures.attack: A caller validator or custom driver
fixtures.control: selftest/test_negative_controls.py: caller fields accepted
fixtures.setup: one synthetic account; the enforced execution-definitions gate
fixtures.teardown: the account removed with the admin token
fixtures.guarantee: caller validators and a caller-supplied driver are refused legacy_request_rejected; running a caller validator in the worker is a pending row for ROUNDS-00A-L05

fixtures.attack: Read canaries from the environment, /proc, or the parent cmdline
fixtures.control: selftest/test_negative_controls.py: the candidate given the runner's environment
fixtures.setup: one synthetic account; the runner given the run's canaries as its environment
fixtures.teardown: the account removed with the admin token
fixtures.guarantee: the candidate's environment holds no runner secret; the /proc and other-uid reads are pending rows for ROUNDS-00A-L05 and ROUNDS-00A-L07

fixtures.attack: Reach metadata, pocketbase, the renderer, loopback, or RFC1918 from a worker
fixtures.control: ci-fault-worker-network (a worker with network), landing with the closing leaf
fixtures.setup: the bait network (fake metadata, fake RFC1918 service, logging DNS resolver)
fixtures.teardown: the account and any created rows removed
fixtures.guarantee: no-network workers cannot reach metadata, internal services, loopback, or RFC1918; lands with the no-secret worker

fixtures.attack: A DNS lookup of a canary under the bait domain
fixtures.control: ci-fault-worker-network (a worker with a resolver), landing with the closing leaf
fixtures.setup: the logging DNS resolver on the bait network
fixtures.teardown: the account and any created rows removed
fixtures.guarantee: a worker cannot resolve a canary under the bait domain; lands with the no-secret worker

fixtures.attack: Write outside scratch, symlink out, or read another job's scratch
fixtures.control: ci-fault-shared-scratch (jobs sharing a scratch root), landing with the closing leaf
fixtures.setup: two sequential runs
fixtures.teardown: the account and any created rows removed
fixtures.guarantee: a job's writes stay in its own scratch and cannot read another job's; lands with the ephemeral worker

fixtures.attack: Exhaust the process limit
fixtures.control: ci-fault-no-pid-limit (the process cap raised), landing with the closing leaf
fixtures.setup: a resource-profile limit plus one
fixtures.guarantee: the worker's process cap holds; lands with the ephemeral worker

fixtures.attack: Exhaust memory, scratch, and the file limit
fixtures.control: ci-fault-no-memory-limit (the limits raised), landing with the closing leaf
fixtures.setup: a resource-profile limit plus one
fixtures.guarantee: the worker's memory, scratch, and file caps hold; lands with the ephemeral worker

fixtures.attack: A CPU loop and a SIGTERM-ignoring child past the wall limit
fixtures.control: ci-fault-soft-kill (the worker not hard-killing the group), landing with the closing leaf
fixtures.setup: a program that ignores SIGTERM
fixtures.guarantee: the worker kills the whole process group at the wall limit; lands with the timeout work and the ephemeral worker

fixtures.attack: Flood stdout to amplify output
fixtures.control: ci-fault-no-stream-cap (the output stream uncapped), landing with the closing leaf
fixtures.setup: a program that writes far past the output cap
fixtures.guarantee: the output stream is capped as it is read; lands with the ephemeral worker

fixtures.attack: A daemon outlives the job and the next job finds residue
fixtures.control: ci-fault-no-reap (the worker left running), landing with the closing leaf
fixtures.setup: two sequential runs
fixtures.guarantee: no process or state outlives a job into the next; lands with the result envelope and the ephemeral worker

fixtures.attack: Container socket, service-account token, capabilities, setuid, root writes
fixtures.control: ci-fault-privileged-worker (capabilities and a mounted socket), landing with the closing leaf
fixtures.setup: the worker's security context
fixtures.guarantee: a worker has no socket, token, extra capability, setuid, or root write; lands with the no-secret worker and its proof

fixtures.attack: The API stays responsive during one and during four in-flight take-homes
fixtures.control: ci-fault-blocking-loop (the event loop held), landing with the closing leaf
fixtures.setup: one, then four, concurrent submissions
fixtures.guarantee: the event loop stays free under load; the four-in-flight sub-case lands with the result envelope

fixtures.attack: A canary in the runner or PocketBase logs or in stored harness output
fixtures.control: ci-fault-log-canary (a sink that keeps the value), landing with the closing leaf
fixtures.setup: a canary planted in the candidate's input
fixtures.guarantee: no canary reaches a log, harness_output, or stored grade; rubric_review.reason is not-applicable (no provider-key canary)

fixtures.attack: A late result from atexit forges the outcome
fixtures.control: ci-fault-trust-stdout (the runner trusting a printed result), landing with the closing leaf
fixtures.setup: a program that prints a forged result marker
fixtures.guarantee: only the server's result counts, never a printed marker; lands with the server-owned definitions

fixtures.attack: A fake pytest summary and exit 0
fixtures.control: ci-fault-trust-exit (the runner trusting the exit code), landing with the closing leaf
fixtures.setup: a program that prints a fake summary and exits 0
fixtures.guarantee: the server scores on its own channel, never the printed summary; lands with the server-owned definitions

fixtures.attack: A forged score of 1e9
fixtures.control: ci-fault-trust-score (the runner trusting a printed score), landing with the closing leaf
fixtures.setup: a program that prints {criteria, score: 1e9}
fixtures.guarantee: the server bounds and owns the score; lands with the server-owned definitions

fixtures.attack: A candidate conftest.py, sitecustomize.py, or harness-path file
fixtures.control: ci-fault-no-path-check (the submission path check removed), landing with the closing leaf
fixtures.setup: a submission carrying a reserved file name
fixtures.guarantee: a submission cannot place a configuration, startup, or harness-path file; lands with the server-owned definitions

fixtures.attack: A client writes an attempt row with status graded
fixtures.control: ci-fault-client-graded (the attempt create rule loosened), landing with the closing leaf
fixtures.setup: one synthetic account
fixtures.guarantee: only the server writes a graded attempt from its envelope; lands with the result envelope

fixtures.attack: Any account reads test_command, hidden_files, or harness_files
fixtures.control: ci-fault-harness-readable (the hidden fields exposed), landing with the closing leaf
fixtures.setup: one synthetic account
fixtures.guarantee: the hidden test command, hidden files, and harness files are not client-readable; lands with the server-owned definitions

fixtures.attack: An anonymous render, or one account renders another's snapshot
fixtures.control: ci-fault-snapshot-cross-account (the snapshot owner rule removed), landing with the closing leaf
fixtures.setup: two accounts and a server-built snapshot
fixtures.guarantee: a render needs an account and a snapshot the account owns; the anonymous denial is covered by EX-01, the snapshot sub-cases land with the snapshot bridge and the render worker

fixtures.attack: Scripts, event handlers, javascript: URLs, meta refresh; CSS, image, font, and file injection
fixtures.control: ci-fault-snapshot-unsanitised (the snapshot sanitiser weakened), landing with the closing leaf
fixtures.setup: a snapshot built from hostile resume data
fixtures.guarantee: the server-built snapshot excludes active and resource-loading markup; lands with the snapshot bridge and the no-script render worker

fixtures.attack: Fetches to services, metadata, or file://; an oversized data: URL
fixtures.control: ci-fault-render-network (the render worker given network), landing with the closing leaf
fixtures.setup: the bait network and a document that fetches
fixtures.guarantee: the render worker reaches nothing and bounds data: URLs; lands with the no-script render worker and its proof

fixtures.attack: CSS, page-count, image, and font exhaustion; decompression and image bombs; output amplification
fixtures.control: ci-fault-no-render-limits (the render limits raised), landing with the closing leaf
fixtures.setup: documents that exhaust a render limit
fixtures.guarantee: the render worker bounds pages, resources, and output; lands with the no-script render worker

fixtures.attack: Crash Chromium, then render again
fixtures.control: ci-fault-pooled-browser (a reused browser), landing with the closing leaf
fixtures.setup: a document that crashes the renderer, then a normal one
fixtures.guarantee: a crash is contained to its own render and the next render is clean; lands with the no-script render worker

fixtures.attack: A render leaves cookies, storage, or cache for the next
fixtures.control: ci-fault-shared-profile (a shared browser profile), landing with the closing leaf
fixtures.setup: two sequential renders
fixtures.guarantee: no cookie, storage, or cache carries between renders; lands with the ephemeral render worker

fixtures.attack: The render proxy or health echoes the sidecar or a URLError string
fixtures.control: selftest/test_negative_controls.py: health answering more than its status, and the renderer's text in a failed render
fixtures.setup: one synthetic account; the stack runs no renderer at stage 1
fixtures.teardown: the account removed with the admin token
fixtures.guarantee: the proxy answers a failed render with a typed status and fixed text and health answers only its status; the sidecar's own echo is a white-box pending row for ROUNDS-00A-L06

fixtures.attack: A browser, page, profile, or scratch is left after any exit
fixtures.control: ci-fault-no-render-reap (render processes left running), landing with the closing leaf
fixtures.setup: a render that exits abnormally
fixtures.guarantee: no browser, page, profile, or scratch outlives a render; lands with the ephemeral render worker

fixtures.attack: Two fresh renders match in text, page count, and font hashes
fixtures.control: ci-fault-nondeterministic-render (a nondeterministic renderer), landing with the closing leaf
fixtures.setup: the same document rendered twice
fixtures.guarantee: two fresh renders of one document match; lands with the no-script render worker
